result.scope: Prospective three-arm engineering comparison frozen after accepted compiler foundation, before editor integration/formal v4 timing. Retains all five exact v3 inputs, strict outcomes, exports, outer render clock and seven ordinary warm repeats. Earlier experiments informed this developer-selected workload; not held-out or independent/human evaluation. Original v1/v2/v3 protocols, failures, evaluator and vectors remain. No timing threshold or promised improvement.
